Messages.Author: Rafid Armani
Messages.Body:
On Fri, 13 Oct 2000 04:00:51 GMT, Packer <princede...@yahoo.com>
wrote:

>My question concerns the card "Fragment of the Book of Nod", are there
>restrictions on when it can be tapped to draw 2 cards? (what I mean is
>does it have to be before or between actions? ex. I attempt to bleed
>and I am blocked, before combat can I tap it to draw cards possibly
>stealth or combat cards??)

You can tap it anytime you want. Even if someone makes an action to
steal it from you ; tap it and try to draw your wake. : )

There`s no restriction on the card nor in the errata.

Good luck for saturday... you`ll need it ! : )

Remy Auclair
Quebec
